title: Bag of Bricks - Nougat  32
descriptionHtml:
Nougat — colour 32

The medium skin tone, and the one that gives a face its dimension. Sitting between Light Nougat and Caramel, it shapes cheeks, jawlines and the turn of the nose.

Works well with: Light Nougat 02, Caramel 15, Beige 09

  • Precision-moulded, compatible with all Memobrick kits and standard building bricks
  • Ideal for replacing missing pieces or extending an existing design
  • Supplied in a resealable bag for easy sorting and storage

seo.description: Nougat bricks (colour 32) for Memobrick mosaics. A medium skin tone that adds depth and dimension to faces alongside lighter shades.
